profile.headline: Software Developer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Migrated company data from pure SQL to nosql databases integrated with SQL
• Created data analysis/visualization tools
• Created internal analytics tools
• Built user content management functionality
• Configured TLS authentication system
• Contributed bugfixes and small feature implementations
• Planned large feature implementations with company CTO
• Troubleshot and addressed user issues

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Created server-side software/API for use with internally developed iPad app
• Created website usage tracking and analytic service to collect data for use in research and development
• Implemented index based search features for video sharing and course recommendation websites
• Migrated existing web application to Amazon cloud hosting
• Built password recovery system for educational journal website
• Contributed to development of intelligent course recommendation tool
• Participated in weekly research and development meetings
• Wrote blog posts for educational news blog

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Met with students during regular office hours to discuss and review course material.
• Graded student assignments.
• Proctored and graded exams.

positions.title: Website Administrator
positions.description:
• Developed and managed departmental website and sub-department micro-sites.
• Kept student and faculty profiles current.
• Met with professors to determine needs for sub-department micro-sites.
